title: Parzen window evaluation has high variance and fails in high dimensions
description: The method used to estimate test-set likelihood via Gaussian Parzen windows has high variance and does not perform well in high-dimensional spaces.
canonical_description: evaluation of generative models via Parzen window estimates suffers from high variance and poor scaling to high dimensions

evidence.quote: This method of estimating the likelihood has somewhat high variance and does not perform well in high dimensional spaces but it is the best method available to our knowledge.
